en.t: His premonition had been right after all.

units.source_text: 那女人刚叫他坐下，门厅尽头暖炉的周围，便发出哗的下雨般的响声。

en.t: No sooner had the woman told him to sit down than, around the stove at the far end of the entryway, there came a rushing sound like rain.

units.source_text: 一看，原来是大群的跳蚤。

en.t: When he looked, he saw that it was a swarm of fleas.
But this sort of thing did not frighten him.

units.source_text: 昆虫采集人是经常有所准备的：

en.t: An insect collector is always prepared:

units.source_text: 他在衣服内侧喷上了DDT药水，露在外面的部分，等临睡前再涂抹一些防虫药膏便没事了。

en.t: He had sprayed the inside of his clothes with DDT solution, and as for the exposed parts, it would be enough to rub on a little insect repellent ointment before going to sleep.
